basic_info.description: Horizon Labs builds deterministic execution systems for AI.AI systems today generate decisions probabilistically but execute them without enforcing admissibility at runtime. This leads to invalid state transitions, non-reproducible behavior, and irreversible system failures.We define and implement an execution boundary where every state mutation is gated by admissibility.Core principle:- Probabilistic reasoning generates intent- Deterministic systems execute state changesExecution is allowed only if admissibility conditions are satisfied.Systems developed:- Deterministic Kernel (execution authority layer)- Execution Boundary Architecture- ARSO (Agentic Real Estate Sales Orchestrator)Category:Deterministic Execution SystemsWe work with engineering teams to design and implement execution-safe AI systems in production environments.

basic_profile.summary: An entrepreneur who believes Indian institutions have far more potential than they currently realise, and genuinely enjoys helping them discover it.I'm interested in seeing people and institutions become better than they are today. And I'm willing to contribute something towards making that happen.I work on the execution layer of AI systems.Not model performance.Not prompts.Not experimentation.Execution.I focus on the point where AI moves from output generation to real-world action, where financial, regulatory, and operational consequences begin.This is where most AI systems fail.Not because the model is wrong,but because execution authority was never defined.I design deterministic execution architectures that:• separate intent generation from state mutation• enforce admissibility before execution• ensure replayable, auditable system behavior• eliminate hidden decision logicThis work is formalized through:• Deterministic Execution Kernel (system architecture)• Execution Boundary design (admissibility layer)• Immutable snapshot and replay systemsIn industry settings (insurance, banking, healthcare, public systems), this translates into:• clear decision ownership before automation• threshold and escalation governance• audit-safe execution pipelines• controlled integration of ML and LLM systemsAI does not fail at intelligence.It fails at execution.That is the layer I build.

We are building India’s first Recursive Supply Chain and RTGS-based credit intelligence system, focused on transforming how grocery distribution, retail credit, and product feedback loops operate across the informal retail economy.

The core challenge we solve is not prediction alone, it is decision accountability at scale.

Our systems are designed to:
- Preserve deterministic decisioning where financial and credit risk is involved
- Introduce intelligence only where auditability and explainability can be maintained
- Embed human-in-the-loop control points across credit, replenishment, and dispute flows

Our trust-first infrastructure empowers:

- Retailers with real-time reorder signals and controlled, dynamic credit access
- Manufacturers with SKU-level intelligence and distribution clarity
- Freelance sales teams with verifiable demand and execution signals

We are not just building software.
We are building epistemic infrastructure, systems that learn, adapt, and scale through recursive trust validation rather than opaque automation.

Core innovations:

- Recursive SKU Intelligence
- RTGS (Recursive Trust Graph System)
- Tight integration of decision logic, data signals, and operational workflows

BWG Horizon is a continuously operating system where architectural choices have immediate financial, regulatory, and trust consequences.
current.employer_linkedin_description: BWG Horizon is building India’s first recursive grocery supply system — designed to optimize trust, margin, and movement across every retail node.We serve 1000+ retailers and grocery through a network of loop-based systems that integrate manufacturing, dispatch, real-time feedback, and RTGS-driven credit intelligence.Our product suite includes:•Recursive Dispatch Engine•SKU Intelligence Platform•Retailer App & Credit Trust Layer (RTGS)•Digital Ad Boards for In-Store Activation•MES for Loop-Based Manufacturing•Real-Time Delivery & Feedback SystemsWe don’t just deliver products.We deliver precision, predictability, and performance — one recursive loop at a time.

current.employee_description:
Building deterministic execution systems for AI.

AI systems generate decisions probabilistically but execute them without validating admissibility at runtime. This leads to invalid state transitions, non-reproducible behavior, and irreversible failures.

I design execution boundaries where every state mutation is gated by admissibility.

Core architecture:

- Deterministic Kernel (execution authority layer)
- {ALLOW, BLOCK, ESCALATE} execution primitive
- Fail-closed execution model
- Admissibility-driven state transitions

Systems:

- ARSO (Agentic Real Estate Sales Orchestrator)
- Execution-safe multi-agent coordination frameworks

Focus:

- Enforcing execution correctness in production AI systems
- Designing non-bypassable execution control layers
- Converting probabilistic outputs into deterministic outcomes

This leads to invalid state transitions, non-reproducible behavior, and irreversible system failures.We define and implement an execution boundary where every state mutation is gated by admissibility.Core principle:- Probabilistic reasoning generates intent- Deterministic systems execute state changesExecution is allowed only if admissibility conditions are satisfied.Systems developed:- Deterministic Kernel (execution authority layer)- Execution Boundary Architecture- ARSO (Agentic Real Estate Sales Orchestrator)Category:Deterministic Execution SystemsWe work with engineering teams to design and implement execution-safe AI systems in production environments.

Most software and Web3 companies don’t struggle with building products. They struggle with positioning, demand generation, and consistent lead flow. Across my experience with companies like Zab Technologies, Coinsclone, and Pixel Web Solutions, I’ve focused on building scalable growth systems - combining SEO, content strategy, and targeted acquisition to attract high-intent users globally. From competitive niches like blockchain development and SaaS solutions to broader software services, my work is centered on driving measurable outcomes, not just traffic. I specialize in:  SEO and content strategies for high-competition tech niches (Web3, SaaS, software services)  Building pillar-cluster systems that create long-term organic growth  Hybrid acquisition models (inbound + outbound) targeting global clients  LinkedIn and community-led demand generation  Conversion-focused positioning for technical and product-driven businesses  What I’ve learned working across these domains is simple: 👉 Traffic alone doesn’t build businesses 👉 Positioning + intent-driven acquisition doesCurrently, I’m building a MarTech AI platform designed to automate and streamline marketing and sales systems end-to-end. The goal is to create intelligent workflows that reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and help teams focus on what actually drives growth. This system is being built to support small teams, mid-sized businesses, and solopreneurs in managing their entire acquisition process more efficiently - from lead generation to conversion - using AI-driven automation and smarter execution layers.If you're building in software, SaaS, or Web3 and looking to create a more predictable growth engine, that’s exactly the space I operate in.

basic_info.description: Autonomy earned, not assumed.Efficieno helps enterprises become autonomous — companies that never sleep, never forget, and never wait for Monday — starting with the systems they actually run on: Oracle E-Business Suite and Fusion.For decades, companies kept two kinds of systems: one that records the work, one that reports on it. People carried the answers between them. The autonomous enterprise closes that gap — and we take enterprises there safely, one function at a time, with the Enterprise Agentic System: AI agents that know your business, runs inside your own network, and acts only with approval. Agents earn independence the way people do: correct answers, then correct suggestions, then action with sign-off — each step proven on your own system. Your data never leaves your network.What we offer: 🔹 Enterprise Agentic System — AI agents for Oracle EBS that answer, recommend, and act on approval. First answers in three weeks. 🔹 FusionLink — ODBC/JDBC connectors for Oracle Fusion. Live data in any tool you own. One price, unlimited users. 🔹 Consulting — Applications (Oracle EBS & Fusion), Analytics (no vendor lock-in), Platform Engineering (open source, everything as code).Oracle Partner · ISO 9001 · ISO/IEC 27001. Founded 2024 · 120+ specialists · Pune, India · Serving India, USA & EuropeThe load-bearing work isn't the slow path to the autonomous enterprise. It's the only one that gets there.

past.employer_linkedin_description: OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and Southeast Asia.OYO was founded by 27-year-old Ritesh Agarwal, the first Asian resident to be accepted to the Thiel Fellowship (started by Paypal founder Peter Thiel).OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. Owners and operators of over 157K storefronts use the OYO platform to manage all mission-critical aspects of their business operations. OYO’s comprehensive, full-stack technology suite integrates more than 40 products and services across digital sign-up and onboarding, revenue management, daily business management and D2C stacks into two flagship patron applications, Co-OYO and OYO OS. OYO customers can book storefronts through OYO’s own D2C channels and through indirect channels with third-party OTAs. The OYO App offers a variety of digital tools to guide customers throughout their journey, including discovery, seamless booking, pre-stay assistance, cancellations, digital check-ins as well as in-stay and post-stay services. With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

basic_profile.headline: Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant | BIP | OTBI |  FBDI | BPM | SQL | PLSQL | APEX | OIC | EBS (R11,R12.1.2 to R12.1.7)
basic_profile.name: Nivrutti Tangde
basic_profile.summary:
Oracle Certified Technical Consultant with experience building secure and scalable business solutions using Oracle APEX, E-Business Suite (EBS R12), Oracle Fusion Cloud, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

Skills & Tools
• Languages & DB: PL/SQL, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
• Reporting: BI Publisher, OTBI, XML Publisher, RDF, WebADI, FBDI, HDL
• Integration & Testing: REST/SOAP APIs, WSDL, SOAP UI, Oracle OIC (App-Driven, Scheduled, File-Based)
• Development Tools: Oracle APEX, Oracle Forms/Reports, SQL Developer, TOAD, JDeveloper
• Cloud & DevOps: Git, JIRA, OCI, Oracle Autonomous DB
Oracle APEX – Application Development
• Built secure, responsive low-code apps using APEX Pages, Shared Components, and PL/SQL logic
• Delivered dashboards, reports, and custom charts using Oracle JET
• Integrated Fusion REST/SOAP APIs via APEX_WEB_SERVICE (OAuth 2.0)
• Exposed RESTful services using ORDS and Web Source Modules (JSON/XML)
• Implemented SSO, LDAP, RBAC, and session protection
• Customized UI with Universal Theme, JS, CSS, and mobile-friendly layouts
Oracle EBS R12 –
• Modules: Finance (AP, AR, GL, FA, CM), SCM (PO, INV, OM, BOM, WIP), HRMS (Core HR, Payroll), AOL
• Developed RICE components: Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions
• Created RDF/XML reports, WebADI templates, concurrent programs
• Customized workflows using Oracle Workflow Builder
• Configured value sets, lookups, flexfields, and form personalisation
Oracle Fusion Cloud –
• Modules:
 – Finance Cloud: AP, AR, GL, FA
 – Procurement Cloud: PO, Self-Service Procurement, Supplier Portal
 – HCM Cloud: Core HR, Payroll, Workforce Structures
• Tools & Functional Work:
 – BI Publisher, OTBI, FBDI, HDL, ESS Jobs, ADFdi
 – Built custom reports, data loaders, extracts, and templates
 – Configured DFFs/KFFs, Lookups, Security Roles, Alerts
 – Developed and automated approval workflows and job scheduling
 – Integrated Fusion with external systems via SOAP/REST APIs (tested via SOAP UI)
Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) –
• Designed App-Driven, Scheduled, and File-based integrations with Fusion and third-party systems
• Adapters used: ERP Cloud, HCM Cloud, REST, SOAP, Database, FTP, Email
• Sample Use Cases:
 Load FBDI (Invoices, POs), HDL (Employees, Jobs),
 Trigger ESS Jobs after data load,
 Extract and transform data from Fusion to external systems
• Developed WSDL-based integrations and tested using SOAP UI
• Applied OAuth 2.0, fault handling, logging, and monitoring through OIC dashboards

current.employee_description:
I lead the Decision Intelligence Practice at Efficieno AI, where I help organizations turn enterprise data into decision intelligence — building the analytics, lakehouse, and semantic layers that sit above transactional ERP and actually get used.
My focus is multi-cloud analytics architecture across Oracle and Microsoft Azure. On the Oracle side, that means Fusion Data Intelligence, OAC semantic models, and Autonomous Data Warehouse. On the Azure side, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, and Power BI. Most enterprises I work with run both — the interesting problems live at the seams, where Oracle ERP data has to land in an Azure lakehouse without losing its meaning.
I've delivered large-scale implementations, cloud migrations, modernization programs, and managed services across Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, and Financial Services.

Analytics & data platform - 
Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), OAC semantic modeling, BI Applications, Autonomous Data Warehouse
Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory
Lakehouse architecture, medallion design, Delta Lake, dimensional and semantic modeling
Power BI (enterprise governance, tabular models, RLS), Tableau, Qlik
ODI, Informatica, OCI Data Integration, GoldenGate — batch, CDC, and streaming
Data governance and lineage: Microsoft Purview, catalog and MDM patterns
AI - 
AI-powered automation, agentic AI, and LLM-driven analytics on governed enterprise data
 
Key achievements:
 
8+ BI and self-service analytics transformation programs delivered
Built and scaled global Oracle consulting teams
Helped clients stand up their own data and analytics teams
Delivered solutions across India, USA, Europe, and the Middle East
Designed multi-layer lakehouse architectures for enterprise-scale reporting
Driving convergence of Oracle Cloud, lakehouse platforms, and AI for next-gen intelligent enterprises

past.employer_linkedin_description: Oracle is a global leader in AI, delivering the cloud infrastructure, data, and applications that organizations across the world trust to successfully achieve business outcomes at scale.Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) provides fast, flexible, scalable AI infrastructure. This enables organizations to operationalize AI without compromising data security or control. Oracle Applications embed AI directly into business workflows and industry processes to ensure AI is delivered in context, where work happens. They include the only applications suite that brings AI to every aspect of a business, with AI-powered ERP, HCM, and CX applications, and the Oracle Health Suite which provides applications for managing the entire healthcare ecosystem. Oracle also provides industry-specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries and NetSuite, the world’s first cloud computing company.  This LinkedIn page serves as Oracle’s official global company page.

basic_profile.summary: I build companies that solve complex real-world problems at the intersection of engineering, infrastructure and technology.Previously, I founded GarudaUAV and am a stakeholder in Stesalit Systems, experiences that provided deep exposure to geospatial technologies, infrastructure execution, and mission-critical systems operating at scale.Today, I am building Aagento, a deeptech design automation platform for bridge infrastructure.We are starting with a focused mission: automating General Arrangement Drawings (GADs) for railway and highway bridges, with the goal of extending toward complete detailed bridge design automation in the coming months.Aagento is not a generic software product. We are building an engineering system grounded in structural logic, codebook intelligence (IRS, IRC, RDSO, and MoRT&H), and a connected design pipeline. The core innovation lies in the geometry engine and domain-specific rules that enable design workflows to be automated with engineering rigor.We believe bridge design can be fundamentally reimagined—from fragmented spreadsheets, CAD files, and manual reviews to an integrated system that takes projects from inputs to GAD generation and eventually to compliance-checked, design-ready outputs.At this stage, we are working closely with early partners and users to build with precision and real-world feedback. We are always interested in conversations with bridge engineers, consultants, EPC teams, and infrastructure leaders shaping the future of engineering automation.Building the future of infrastructure requires not just better software, but entirely new workflows

current.employer_linkedin_description: Founded in 2017, GarudaUAV is a leading next-gen geospatial and engineering services company transforming aerial data into actionable business intelligence. We bridge the gap between physical infrastructure and digital intelligence. We provide next-generation geospatial and engineering services, transforming high-resolution aerial data into precise, cloud-based GIS solutions.By combining advanced aerial imaging technologies with automated AI processing, we help enterprises digitise assets, de-risk operations and optimise project lifecycles. From cross-country pipelines and massive highways to renewable energy sites and urban planning, we deliver unmatched accuracy that drives smarter and faster commercial decisions.Our Core Geospatial & GIS Capabilities:Precision Surveying & Aerial Mapping: High-resolution photogrammetry, LiDAR processing, and digital terrain modelling (DTM/DEM).Advanced GIS Services: Geospatial data modelling, layer integration, thematic mapping, and custom GIS database creation.AI-Powered Analytics: Automated defect detection, volumetric analysis, and change detection through our proprietary platform.Asset Inspection & Monitoring: Corridor mapping, thermal inspection, and end-to-end progress tracking for large-scale infrastructure projects.

current.employee_description: As Founder & CEO of GarudaUAV, I led the company’s strategic acquisition of Stesalit and acquired a strategic equity stake in the firm.
current.employer_linkedin_description: Stesalit Systems Ltd has its core focus on the technology triad of Location Intelligence – IoT (Internet of Things) – Analytics to enable its clients know in real time all the important parameters about their assets spread across the geography, moving and stationery, and actuate them as and when required from the central command control. This empowerment helps our clients to maximize the value of their assets by improving the RoI of each of the assets in the framework we build for them.The IoT framework we build connects all the assets, through a cutting edge low power hungry technology, that senses the data generated from the assets and integrates them in to the cloud. The analytical visualization we create is geospatially enabled for ease of decision making by the command control.Our IoT framework and overall solution works as the core technology layer on which a Smart City is built, and spans across other core industry verticals like Agriculture, Transportation, Forestry, Utility, Oil and Gas and can include any network of geographically spread assets.Stesalit means Spreading Light. Stesa means Rising or Spreading in Italian and Lit is Light. Stesalit is an ISO 9001 – 2000 certified and CMMi Level 3 company.

current.employee_description:
I am building Aagento, a deeptech design automation platform for bridge infrastructure.

We are starting with a focused mission: automating General Arrangement Drawings (GADs) for railway and highway bridges, with the goal of extending toward complete detailed bridge design automation in the coming months.

Aagento is not a generic software product. We are building an engineering system grounded in structural logic, codebook intelligence (IRS, IRC, RDSO, and MoRT&H), and a connected design pipeline. The core innovation lies in the geometry engine and domain-specific rules that enable design workflows to be automated with engineering rigor.

We believe bridge design can be fundamentally reimagined—from fragmented spreadsheets, CAD files, and manual reviews to an integrated system that takes projects from inputs to GAD generation and eventually to compliance-checked, design-ready outputs.
current.employer_linkedin_description: We are building Aagento the definitive deeptech design automation platform for bridge infrastructure.After months of focused engineering in stealth, we are soft-launching with a clear mission: to automate General Arrangement Drawings (GAD) for railway and highway bridges, and completely transform the detailed design workflow.Aagento is not a generic software wrapper. It is a foundational engineering system built on real structural logic, core geometry engines, and deep codebook intelligence (IRS, IRC, RDSO, MoRT&H). We believe bridge design must move beyond fragmented spreadsheets, AutoCAD files, and manual approval loops. We are replacing them with a single, connected pipeline that takes a project from raw inputs to compliance-checked, design-ready output.We are currently opening our platform to a limited group of partners. We are looking for forward-thinking bridge engineers, consultants, EPC teams, and infrastructure leaders to help shape the future of this domain alongside us.If you believe infrastructure deserves a smarter, faster design stack join the waitlist for limited early access.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Kolkata (IISER Kolkata) was established in 2006 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), Government of India. IISER Kolkata is designed to reach the prestigious position in the global setting that IISc, IIMs and IITs presently enjoy. IISER Kolkata is an autonomous institution awarding its own degrees. The central theme of the IISER Kolkata is to integrate education with research so that undergraduate teaching as well as doctoral and postdoctoral research work could be carried out in symbiosis.IISER-K has completed more than ten years of its existence and has established excellence in science in form of teaching, publications, both in terms of quality and quantity. Many under graduate students are also engaged in research as a part of their curriculum. IISER-K today has a vibrant campus with strong faculty members of repute and supportive non-teaching staff members. The students pursuing various degrees are among the best in the country and have established a commendable culture.The Institute has a flexible academic programme and hosts state-of-the-art research facilities. Currently, it has five academic departments (Biological Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Earth Sciences, Mathematics & Statistics, Physical Sciences) and several centres of excellence: (1) Center of Excellence in Space Sciences in India (CESSI) supported by Ministry of Human Resource Development, (2) National Centre for High Pressure Studies, supported by the Ministry of Earth Sciences. An institute supported “Centre for Advanced Functional Materials (CAFM)” has also been established recently. Two interdisciplinary centres (1) Centre for Climate and Environmental Studies (CCES) and Centre for Large Scale Computing (CLSC) are being created with the Institute initiative.

past.employer_linkedin_description: ANRA Technologies is an international provider of end-to-end solutions for unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) operators and airspace managers. Headquartered in Washington, DC with additional offices in Asia and Europe, the team includes folks like Michael Whitaker, former Deputy Administrator of the FAA, senior software engineers, air traffic experts, computer engineers, system design architects, and FAA-certified manned and remote pilots. ANRA offers two software platforms for UAS Traffic Management (UTM) and Workflow orchestration platforms which can be deployed individually or combined into a comprehensive service package for an ANSP, regulator or a commercial enterprise. Each platform is comprised of microservices that are designed to scale to support millions of drones. These two software platforms include features such as discovery/authentication/registration services, mission planning, command and control, automated flight paths, dynamic flight routing, data processing, fleet management, traffic management, and open interfaces to enable integration into ATC as well as emerging capabilities like remote identification of drones. Both the platforms have been rigorously tested and vetted by the world’s foremost government aviation entities and are operational today at multiple test sites, commercial enterprises and UAS corridors. Our solution provides operators and analysts access to the Command and Control for one or multiple UAV operations at any given time.The control can be delegated to users at multiple geographical locations using our Cloud based Control Station.Our module on board the UAVs enables the analysts to get access to the EO/IR or other sensors in real time over the encrypted links coming down to local or cloud based control station. The data also gets archived in our secure cloud for additional post processing and analytics.

An institute supported “Centre for Advanced Functional Materials (CAFM)” has also been established recently. Two interdisciplinary centres (1) Centre for Climate and Environmental Studies (CCES) and Centre for Large Scale Computing (CLSC) are being created with the Institute initiative.

past.employer_linkedin_description: ANRA Technologies is an international provider of end-to-end solutions for unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) operators and airspace managers. Headquartered in Washington, DC with additional offices in Asia and Europe, the team includes folks like Michael Whitaker, former Deputy Administrator of the FAA, senior software engineers, air traffic experts, computer engineers, system design architects, and FAA-certified manned and remote pilots. ANRA offers two software platforms for UAS Traffic Management (UTM) and Workflow orchestration platforms which can be deployed individually or combined into a comprehensive service package for an ANSP, regulator or a commercial enterprise. Each platform is comprised of microservices that are designed to scale to support millions of drones. These two software platforms include features such as discovery/authentication/registration services, mission planning, command and control, automated flight paths, dynamic flight routing, data processing, fleet management, traffic management, and open interfaces to enable integration into ATC as well as emerging capabilities like remote identification of drones. Both the platforms have been rigorously tested and vetted by the world’s foremost government aviation entities and are operational today at multiple test sites, commercial enterprises and UAS corridors. Our solution provides operators and analysts access to the Command and Control for one or multiple UAV operations at any given time.The control can be delegated to users at multiple geographical locations using our Cloud based Control Station.Our module on board the UAVs enables the analysts to get access to the EO/IR or other sensors in real time over the encrypted links coming down to local or cloud based control station. The data also gets archived in our secure cloud for additional post processing and analytics.

basic_info.description: GameGenesis didn’t come out of nowhere.It kicked off with one developer who couldn’t stop building — late nights, broken builds, and a beat-up laptop that ran hot enough to cook breakfast. There was no funding, no fancy setup, just a passion for games and a ridiculous amount of trial and error.Fast-forward a few years, and that one-man grind turned into a team. A couple of sharp minds from the industry joined in, saw the spark, and brought the fire. Now we’re a small-but-deadly game dev studio that moves fast, thinks sharp, and delivers like a heavyweight.We do the full game dev thing—concept, design, code, art, animation, polish. basic_info.description: Hiring is chaos. In the AI-native world especially, the noise drowns the signal — resumes, referrals, gut calls, and vibes masquerading as evidence.Everyone loses in this fog. Candidates get ghosted. Recruiters get blamed for outcomes they couldn't control. Hiring managers decide on instinct and hope. Three people, one broken loop, no shared truth.Ratch exists to bring a sense of shared truth to this loop, and clarity and confidence to every hire.We are evidence-based decision intelligence for hiring. Not another sourcing tool. Not a faster funnel. A system that separates signal from noise and puts judgment on record.Every hire produces a structured, audit-trailed artifact — a Decision File — that shows why, not just who. Candidates get a fair, transparent process. Recruiters get defensible ground to stand on. Hiring managers get conviction backed by evidenceThe economics follow the outcome, not the activity. We win when the decision is right.Hiring shouldn't run on gut. It should run on signal.Ratch. Clarity. Confidence. On record. Decision Infrastructure

past.employer_linkedin_description: Ashok Leyland vehicles have built a reputation for reliability and ruggedness. The 5,00,000 vehicles we have put on the roads have considerably eased the additional pressure placed on road transportation in independent India.In the populous Indian metros, four out of the five State Transport Undertaking (STU) buses come from Ashok Leyland. Some of them like the double-decker and vestibule buses are unique models from Ashok Leyland, tailor-made for high-density routes.The blueprint prepared for the future reflected the global ambitions of the company, captured in four words: Global Standards, Global Markets. This was at a time when liberalisation and globalisation were not yet in the air. Ashok Leyland embarked on a major product and process upgradation to match world-class standards of technology.In the journey towards global standards of quality, Ashok Leyland reached a major milestone in 1993 when it became the first in India's automobile history to win the ISO 9002 certification. The more comprehensive ISO 9001 certification came in 1994, QS 9000 in 1998 and ISO 14001 certification for all vehicle manufacturing units in 2002. It has also become the first Indian auto company to receive the latest ISO/TS 16949 Corporate Certification (in July 2006) which is specific to the auto industry.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Ashok Leyland vehicles have built a reputation for reliability and ruggedness. The 5,00,000 vehicles we have put on the roads have considerably eased the additional pressure placed on road transportation in independent India.In the populous Indian metros, four out of the five State Transport Undertaking (STU) buses come from Ashok Leyland. Some of them like the double-decker and vestibule buses are unique models from Ashok Leyland, tailor-made for high-density routes.The blueprint prepared for the future reflected the global ambitions of the company, captured in four words: Global Standards, Global Markets. This was at a time when liberalisation and globalisation were not yet in the air. Ashok Leyland embarked on a major product and process upgradation to match world-class standards of technology.In the journey towards global standards of quality, Ashok Leyland reached a major milestone in 1993 when it became the first in India's automobile history to win the ISO 9002 certification. The more comprehensive ISO 9001 certification came in 1994, QS 9000 in 1998 and ISO 14001 certification for all vehicle manufacturing units in 2002. It has also become the first Indian auto company to receive the latest ISO/TS 16949 Corporate Certification (in July 2006) which is specific to the auto industry.

past.employee_description:
The Router chain is a layer 1 blockchain that leverages Tendermint’s Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) consensus engine.
My work is to organise and represent Router in different colleges, Meetups and Hackathon in the vicinity of Chandigarh City.
past.employer_linkedin_description: Router Protocol is a pioneering cross-chain solution that enables secure and efficient communication between blockchain networks. The L1 Router Chain uses Tendermint’s BFT consensus to address interoperability challenges while enhancing security and scalability through decentralisation. The Chain enables cross-chain meta transactions, stateful bridging, transaction batching, and batch atomicity, providing a modular framework for building cross-chain dApps in web3. The use cases range from cross-chain NFTs, cross-chain governance, and cross-chain stablecoins to cross-chain oracles and cross-chain marketplaces. Router's CrossTalk library is an extensible cross-chain framework that enables seamless state transitions across multiple chains, supporting both stateful and stateless bridging.Router Nitro is LIVE  https://app.routernitro.com/swap

basic_profile.summary:
Founder & CEO of Zeto Studio, where products, AI systems, and scalable digital platforms are built with a strong focus on clarity, execution, and long-term value.

A builder’s mindset has always been at the center of the journey. From early leadership experiences and product experimentation in college to building real systems for real-world use cases, the path has been shaped by one consistent belief: technology, when applied with the right understanding of the problem, can solve far more than most people imagine.

Zeto Studio operates with a product-first approach, building its own AI-driven products while also working with startups and enterprises that need fast execution, strong architecture, and software built for scale. One of the most exciting areas of focus today is omnichannel agentic customer experience, where AI, workflows, and business operations come together to create practical value.

The work is grounded in execution. MVPs are shipped in under 30 days. Products built by the team are scaling toward 1M+ users. The engineering team is growing actively, with hiring across multiple technical roles. Across edtech, healthcare, enterprise, fintech, ecommerce, and logistics, the goal remains the same: build solutions that are fast to launch, strong at the core, and ready to grow.

The intersection of product thinking, AI systems, and enterprise-grade execution is where the strongest opportunities exist. Building in that space means solving hard problems, creating with intent, and turning ambitious ideas into dependable systems.

Always open to connecting with people building meaningful technology, ambitious products, and long-term impact.
